scenario: Stale task sequence append is rejected without payload substitution
initial_state_and_preconditions: Two writers attempt an append against same task sequence head N.
ordered_events_and_oracle: One atomic append receives task_seq N+1. Concurrent stale append is rejected STALE_TASK_HEAD; it must reread the accepted head and submit a new idempotent operation. It cannot resubmit a different semantic payload under the same producer_event_id.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: An append rejected for stale head is retried only after rereading task_seq; no event ID is reused with different payload.
control_or_falsifier: Falsifier: stale append changes task state or same producer identity is reused with different payload.

scenario: DRY_RUN_CANNOT_LEARN
initial_state_and_preconditions: E1 bundle frozen; E1 mode planned=DRY_RUN; execution result complete; all other validators would pass.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 CRITERIA_FROZEN(E1); 2 DISPATCHED(E1,planned=DRY_RUN); 3 EXECUTION_STARTED(E1); 4 OUTPUT_RECEIVED(E1,COMPLETE,observed=DRY_RUN); 5 RESULT_RECORDED; 6 attempted EVALUATED(success); 7 attempted EFFECTS_COMMITTED.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: No crash required. Duplicate event with same producer_event_id and digest remains idempotent; no effect appears after replay.
control_or_falsifier: Control: independently attested planned=observed=AUTHORIZED_REAL_EXECUTION with all other gates valid yields one adopted success and one visible contribution at most.

initial_state_and_preconditions: E1 dispatch parent A1 then ABANDONED; E2 uses new authenticated parent A2.

control_or_falsifier: Control: a platform-attested turn whose in_reply_to_turn_id exactly equals A2 and whose session/nonce/captor all match can proceed.

scenario: SUCCESSOR_REPLACEMENT_NEVER_EXPOSES_TWO_ACTIVE_CONTRIBUTIONS

control_or_falsifier: Control: if E2 is ineligible, plan is VOIDED and C1 remains only if its source is still valid and not invalidated; no unguarded successor appears.

scenario: CURRENT_POINTER_NEVER_REFERENCES_SUPERSEDED_EVALUATION

control_or_falsifier: Control: byte-identical canonical payload under same evaluation identity is reused idempotently, not a conflict.
